items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: Of course, we had good fortune of having a man who was a wonderful promoter, Patty Harmon. ... I went in with Patty with five pieces. ... I went to see him and ask him if he'd give me a chance with this outfit.

ctx.x: Of course, we had good fortune of having a man who was a wonderful promoter, Patty Harmon.
Oh, yes, I must have asked about that.
